generate_cow_renders: generate 40 rendered views of a cow mesh from uniformly distributed azimuth angles using PyTorch3D
run_generate_cow_renders: run generate_cow_renders to produce camera views, RGB images, and binary silhouettes of a cow mesh
review_generate_cow_renders: review generate_cow_renders to understand how FoVPerspectiveCameras, SoftPhongShader, and SoftSilhouetteShader are composed
refactor_generate_cow_renders: refactor generate_cow_renders to accept a custom OBJ mesh path instead of the hardcoded cow mesh
summarize_generate_cow_renders: summarize generate_cow_renders which loads a cow OBJ mesh, normalizes it, and renders images and silhouettes from multiple viewpoints
